summary: Cabin site on the St. Joe National Forest, Shoshone County, Idaho, dated 1915; listed as abandoned and gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone with no date; sources say the cabin was abandoned but give no year

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as a hike-in

events.note: Listed as a cabin dated 1915; the listings do not name a builder or purpose

evidence.supports: cabin dated 1915, listed as abandoned with no year

notes_for_editor: Thin record: no builder, purpose, staff, fire history or abandonment year in any source read. The three cabin listings agree on 1915. The brief's kind 'ground' matches the FFLA type column. Coordinates come from the FFLA index row (46.99960, -115.73880). No photo found. No source describes what remains or whether the site is public; the story says so. Elevation is unrecorded on both lookout pages, so none is given.
